title: Jailbreaking the Simulation with George Hotz | SXSW 2019
summary: George Hotz gives a SXSW 2019 talk on the idea that we live in a simulation and asks what actions would be available from inside it. He takes a hacker's view of whether it could be escaped.
why: Shared in simulation-argument threads as an entertaining, hacker-minded take, though some commenters criticize Hotz himself.

quote.text: He's taking the hacker's perspective and exploring if the simulation would be hackable from inside.
